note: Each suppression clears one high-signal static finding whose safety rests on an out-of-band guard. Every entry was manually verified against the source. Fingerprints are line-independent (SQL / key-expr / trimmed line) so they survive unrelated edits but change when the guarded statement itself changes — forcing re-review. A finding with no matching suppression fails CI.

suppressions.reason: Previous-scan lookup within a single domain during scan finalize. Filtered by domain_id, which is the domain currently being scanned for the owning workspace; timeline-trust runs inside the scan pipeline for that workspace's own domain.
suppressions.contract: domain_id is caller/workspace-validated before the scan runs; the ORDER-BY-LIMIT-1 selects the prior scan of the same owned domain, never a cross-tenant row.

suppressions.reason: Bootstrap-workspace no-op: SELECT ... FROM workspaces WHERE id IN (${placeholders}). The placeholder list is getAccessibleWorkspaceIds(user) — the caller's own authorized workspaces.
suppressions.contract: The IN-list is the authenticated caller's accessible-workspace set; LIMIT 1 returns the caller's own first workspace, never a foreign one.

suppressions.reason: R2.delete(o.key) inside workspace purge, deleting per-workspace branding logo objects. o.key comes from env.cybermeters_reports.list({ prefix: 'branding/logos/{workspaceId}/' }), so every key is tenant-prefixed with the workspace being purged.
suppressions.contract: The deleted keys are enumerated from a workspace-prefixed R2 list during that workspace's own hard-delete; no foreign object can be selected (validate-purge-completeness proves purge scope).

suppressions.reason: R2.put of a workspace logo. The key is workspaceLogoKey(workspaceId, sha256, ext) = branding/logos/{workspaceId}/{sha256}.ext — the workspaceId comes from the authenticated, requireWorkspaceRole('workspace:manage')-authorised path parameter, never the request body; the bytes were validated (magic-byte PNG/JPEG) and content-hashed first.
suppressions.contract: The R2 key is tenant-prefixed with the authorised workspaceId and content-addressed by sha256; only a workspace manager can write it, and the object is immutable.

suppressions.reason: R2.put of an MSP branding-profile logo. The key is mspLogoKey(ownerId, sha256, ext) = branding/msp/{ownerId}/{sha256}.ext — ownerId is the authenticated account (user.id), the account is white_label-entitled, and the bytes were validated + content-hashed first.
suppressions.contract: The R2 key is prefixed with the authenticated account owner id and content-addressed; only the account owner (session, not api-token) can write it.

suppressions.reason: R2.get(descriptor.logo_r2_key) loads a report logo. The key is tenant-prefixed and content-addressed (branding/logos/{workspace_id}/{sha256}.ext or branding/msp/{owner_user_id}/...), resolved from a workspace-scoped workspace_branding row or an owner-scoped msp_branding_profiles row, and the loaded bytes are verified against the frozen logo_sha256 before use.
suppressions.contract: The logo key is derived from a tenant-scoped D1 row (never the request body) and the bytes are sha256-integrity-checked; a foreign or tampered object fails the hash check and falls back to the CyberMeters mark.

suppressions.reason: R2.get(row.r2_key) where row is a scan_report_snapshots row already fetched under workspace/scan scope; r2_key is the tenant-prefixed object key stored on that row.
suppressions.contract: The D1 row is ownership-scoped before its r2_key is used; the key is bound to the workspace by construction (reports/snapshots/<workspace>/...).

suppressions.reason: R2.get(KEV_CACHE_KEY) — the CISA Known-Exploited-Vulnerabilities catalogue is global reference data cached once for the whole platform.
suppressions.contract: Global reference cache; contains no tenant data, so a constant key is correct.

suppressions.reason: R2.put(KEV_CACHE_KEY) — writes the global KEV catalogue cache.
suppressions.contract: Global reference cache; no tenant data.

suppressions.reason: R2.delete(s.r2_key) inside workspace purge; s is a scan row belonging to the workspace being purged.
suppressions.contract: Purge iterates only the target workspace's own scans; r2_key comes from those tenant-scoped rows (validate-purge-completeness proves no cross-tenant object is touched).

suppressions.reason: R2.delete(`reports/${s.id}.json`) inside workspace purge; s.id is a scan of the workspace being purged.
suppressions.contract: Purge is scoped to the target workspace's scans (validate-purge-completeness).

suppressions.reason: R2.head("__readiness_probe__") in the /ready health check — a constant infrastructure key.
suppressions.contract: Readiness probe; no tenant data.

suppressions.reason: R2.get(`reports/${s.id}.json`) where s is drawn from a workspace-scoped scan query inside an authenticated workspace route.
suppressions.contract: The enclosing route is workspace-authorized (see entry-point inventory); s.id derives from the workspace's own domains/scans.

suppressions.reason: R2.get(`reports/${sid}.json`) where sid is a scan id from workspace-scoped scan rows inside an authenticated workspace route.
suppressions.contract: Enclosing route is workspace-authorized; sid comes from the workspace's own scans.

suppressions.reason: R2.get(`reports/${s.id}.json`) during stuck-scan reconciliation; s comes from the caller's workspace-scoped scan list result.
suppressions.contract: The scan list is already filtered to the caller's accessible scans; s.id is therefore ownership-scoped.

suppressions.reason: body.workspace_id selects a candidate workspace, then requireWorkspaceRole(user, workspaceId, ...) re-validates membership before any action.
suppressions.contract: Body-provided workspace_id is never trusted for authorization; the server re-validates membership/role.

suppressions.reason: body.plan is the plan the customer chooses to purchase, validated against the server-side price map; not an authorization decision.
suppressions.contract: Plan input is validated against the server plan catalogue; it grants no cross-tenant access.

suppressions.reason: parseCheckoutPlan(body.plan) validates the requested checkout plan against the server catalogue.
suppressions.contract: Plan input validated server-side; not an authz decision.

suppressions.reason: body.workspace_id selects a candidate workspace for scan creation, then requireWorkspaceRole(user, workspaceId, 'scan:create') re-validates before the scan is queued.
suppressions.contract: Server re-validates membership/role; body value never trusted for authorization.

suppressions.reason: body.workspace_id selects a candidate workspace for a scheduled scan, re-validated by requireWorkspaceRole before the schedule is written.
suppressions.contract: Server re-validates membership/role; body value never trusted for authorization.

suppressions.reason: body.role is the role to assign on invitation, validated against a server-side ceiling (the actor's requireWorkspaceRole result caps assignable roles).
suppressions.contract: Assignable role is validated against the actor's own role ceiling; a member can never assign a role above their permission.

suppressions.reason: body.role on member-add, validated against the actor's role ceiling allowlist.
suppressions.contract: Role validated against actor ceiling; no privilege escalation via body.

suppressions.reason: body.role on role-change, validated against a CHANGEABLE_ROLES set derived from the actor's role (admins cannot promote to admin; owners have no ceiling).
suppressions.contract: Assigned role is bounded by the actor's own role; requireWorkspaceRole('workspace:invite') is checked before the body is read.
